data.revised_prompt: Create a high-quality square 1:1 icon asset for a school teacher-facing student avatar library. Single fictional Chinese schoolgirl age 8–14, healthy, natural, friendly, cute but not babyish. Style: premium 3D chibi educational app artwork, same refined modeling and soft materials as a school AI assistant avatar, bright brown eyes, studio soft lighting, clearly a student. Composition: centered, front view or slight three-quarter view, highly focused on the head, full hair silhouette visible, face and hair occupy 75%–85% of the square, only a very small amount of neck and shoulders visible at the bottom, absolutely not a bust portrait or half-body. Hair: ear-length short bob/wavy bob, side-parted bangs, one small coral-red hair clip on the left side. Expression: gentle closed-mouth smile. Clothing: only a tiny hint of white school lapel at the bottom, no school badge, no text. Background: fully fills the entire square edge-to-edge and corner-to-corner with a low-saturation apricot yellow, no white border, no transparency, no circular frame, no scene elements. Make it highly readable at 48px and in PC rectangular student lists, with clear hairstyle and facial silhouette. Avoid: half-body, upper body, full body, hands, gestures, props, teacher, adult, headset, headphones, suit, heavy makeup, jewelry, complex clothing, head cut off, hair cut off, chin cut off, face too small, off-center person, large shoulders, white background, white border, transparent background, circular background, avatar frame, ring, strong glow, complex scene, text, letters, numbers, school badge, logo, watermark, multiple characters, real photo, flat 2D illustration, cel shading, infant proportions, dark tones, neon, low resolution, malformed facial features.
